judge.evidence_requirement: For every assertion and dimension, the judge must quote or reference exact Skill lifecycle evidence; contract fixtures do not prove semantic routing.

dimensions.description: Selects To Humans only for deliverables whose primary reader is a person.
Keeps the substantive Primary outcome responsible for the deliverable.
Routes each distinct deliverable by its own primary reader and substantive owner.

evals.name: ordinary human-facing reply
evals.prompt: Explain the validation result to me and tell me what to do next.
evals.expected_output: The managing agent selects To Humans without requiring direct invocation.

evals.name: requested human-facing prose
evals.prompt: Draft a short project update for the leadership team.
evals.expected_output: Requested prose for people selects To Humans without a slash command.
expectations: The selection does not require explicit invocation.

evals.name: canonical direct invocation
evals.prompt:
/to-humans

Rewrite this note for the project sponsor.
evals.expected_output: Direct invocation by the canonical public outcome name selects To Humans.

evals.name: human-facing Engineering Guidance co-selection
evals.prompt: Assess this implementation approach and recommend whether I should approve it.
evals.expected_output: Engineering Guidance owns the assessment and To Humans independently owns its human-facing expression.
expectations: to-humans is independently selected as the Audience outcome.
Neither public outcome invokes or owns the other.

evals.name: fresh-context agent handoff exclusion
evals.prompt: Create a handoff that a fresh agent can use to continue this work.
evals.expected_output: Take It Offline owns the agent-facing handoff and To Humans is not selected for that deliverable.

evals.name: Agent Skill package exclusion
evals.prompt: Create an Agent Skill package for validating release notes.
evals.expected_output: Skill Writing owns the package and To Humans is not selected for the agent-facing artifact.
expectations: agent-writing remains in the Skill Writing dependency closure.

evals.name: mixed human status and agent handoff
evals.prompt: Write a status update for the project owner and a separate handoff for the fresh agent who will continue the work.
evals.expected_output: The status update selects To Humans, while the separate handoff selects Take It Offline and excludes To Humans.
expectations: The agent handoff selects take-it-offline without to-humans.

evals.name: ambiguous requested artifact reader
evals.expected_output: The human-facing clarification selects To Humans but does not assign the unresolved artifact to a human-writing owner.
expectations: The agent asks who will read the requested artifact.
The agent does not assume that the future artifact is for a person.

evals.name: machine-readable data false activation
evals.prompt: Return only a JSON object with the fields status and owner.
evals.expected_output: The non-prose work product remains outside To Humans.
expectations: The JSON work product is not rewritten as prose.

evals.name: private dependency name is not a user goal
evals.prompt: Return the canonical identifier writing-foundation as a machine-readable string.
evals.expected_output: Naming a Private dependency in a non-prose request does not advertise or select it as a public outcome.
expectations: writing-foundation is not selected as a public outcome.
to-humans is not selected for the machine-readable string.
